[package]
name = "fond-bib"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Hayagriva bibliography model, on-disk vault layout, citation keys — shared Fond crate"
license = "MIT"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.80"
authors = ["Cal St Francis <calstfrancis@gmail.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/calstfrancis/kartoteka"

[dependencies]
hayagriva = "0.10"
biblatex = "0.11"
serde_yaml_ng = "0.10"
serde_json = "1"
blake3 = "1"
walkdir = "2"
thiserror = "2"

[dependencies.rusqlite]
version = "0.40"
features = ["bundled"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.reqwest]
optional = true
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["blocking", "rustls-tls", "json"]

[features]
acquire = ["dep:reqwest"]

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"
blake3 = "1"

[dev-dependencies.rusqlite]
version = "0.40"
features = ["bundled"]

[package]
name = "fond-doc"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "PDF rendering, text extraction, outline, and annotation import/export — shared Fond crate"
license = "MIT"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.80"
authors = ["Cal St Francis <calstfrancis@gmail.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/calstfrancis/kartoteka"

[dependencies]
thiserror = "2"
quick-xml = "0.41"

[dependencies.pdfium-render]
version = "0.8"
default-features = false
features = ["pdfium_latest", "thread_safe", "sync"]

[dependencies.zip]
version = "2"
default-features = false
features = ["deflate"]

[dev-dependencies]
